item.title: Winter Olympics: Chock and Bates say their near-perfect skate felt like a win
item.description: MILAN — U.S. ice dancers Madison Chock and Evan Bates didn’t conceal their disappointment Thursday at the bittersweet Olympic silver medal for what Bates called their “absolute best performance,” while Chock said the confusion over the result “does a disservice to our sport.”

item.title: Search for Nancy Guthrie now seeks nearby security videos from the month before she vanished
item.description: TUCSON, Ariz. — Investigators in Arizona want residents near Nancy Guthrie 's home to share surveillance camera footage of suspicious cars or people they may have noticed in the month before she disappeared.

item.title: Red dresses, real stories inspire action at Toledo’s Go Red for Women luncheon
item.description: Hyfah Hilou is alive today because she advocated for herself.

item.title: St. Francis top seed, Northview second in regional hockey tournament
item.description: St. Francis de Sales will be the No. 1 seed in the northwest Ohio regional high school hockey tournament.

item.title: Daisy is Wood County’s top dog name for 2026, auditor says
item.description: BOWLING GREEN — Nearly 11,000 dogs were registered in Wood County for 2026, with mixed-breed dogs and dogs named Daisy leading the pack.

item.title: BGSU football promotes Bowden to defensive coordinator, headlining shifts to coaching staff
item.description: BOWLING GREEN — The Bowling Green State University football team announced the promotion of Joe Bowden to defensive coordinator and the hiring of Greg Froelich as special teams coordinator on Thursday.

item.title: Lima Senior cruises past Start to claim 3rd straight City League boys basketball title
item.description: Lima Senior’s rampage through the City League continued on Thursday with the Spartans claiming their third boys basketball title in three seasons competing in the conference.

item.title: High school boys basketball: Gibsonburg dominant in victory over Woodmore
item.description: Aiden Morant scored 21 points, Xander Zimmerman had 11 points, and Gibsonburg maintained its lead in the Sandusky Bay Conference River Division with a 69-41 boys basketball victory Thursday over Woodmore.

item.title: High school girls basketball: Northview girls fend off Whitmer in NLL Buckeye finale
item.description: Northview girls basketball held off visiting Whitmer 36-34 on the final night of play in the Northern Lakes League Buckeye Division for both teams.

item.title: Editorial: Save Oregon development
item.description: If Oregon owned a flock of geese laying golden eggs, city council would decline to feed them. The current configuration of elected officials — it would be wrong to call them city leaders — are doing their best to undo the good work of past Oregon officials and threaten to derail a $2 billion development.
